title: Confront Aengus about the DNA

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: Ahh I see you are back. I hope that Marius fellow took the news well.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ahh I see you are back. I hope that Marius fellow took the news well.

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: Humans are funny that way. What can I help you with?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Humans are funny that way. What can I help you with?

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: Firstly I do not lose things. Secondly, this DNA had been cast out to the winds already? Anyone with half a brain could do the same work I've done.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Firstly I do not lose things. Secondly, this DNA had been cast out to the winds already? Anyone with half a brain could do the same work I've done.

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: Let me try and put this in human terms. Would you burn one of your own paintings? Would you crush a childhood swimming trophy? Why should I delete my achievements?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let me try and put this in human terms. Would you burn one of your own paintings? Would you crush a childhood swimming trophy? Why should I delete my achievements?

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: I might reconsider my position given the right... compensation.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I might reconsider my position given the right... compensation.

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: Well after our little conversation, I did a little digging around the feet... foot... of Marius Mitchell. Seems like he's been climbing the ranks rather quickly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well after our little conversation, I did a little digging around the feet... foot... of Marius Mitchell. Seems like he's been climbing the ranks rather quickly.

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: I have heard word that he's experimenting with a new kind of brisket glaze and people are going crazy for it... I want it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have heard word that he's experimenting with a new kind of brisket glaze and people are going crazy for it... I want it.

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: Seems reasonable to me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Seems reasonable to me.

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: You don't think I've tried! For some reason it always misses the mark. He must be approaching it from a completely new angle. I want that angle.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You don't think I've tried! For some reason it always misses the mark. He must be approaching it from a completely new angle. I want that angle.

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: If the man failed to read the fine-print on his own leg deal that's not my problem.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If the man failed to read the fine-print on his own leg deal that's not my problem.

nodes.speaker: Aengus Prince
nodes.text: So many are.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So many are.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think he just needed the closure.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think he just needed the closure.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think he just needed the closure.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think he just needed the closure.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You mentioned that you store quite a lot of DNA information. That seems pretty unsafe, what if you lost it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You mentioned that you store quite a lot of DNA information. That seems pretty unsafe, what if you lost it?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You mentioned that you store quite a lot of DNA information. That seems pretty unsafe, what if you lost it?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You mentioned that you store quite a lot of DNA information. That seems pretty unsafe, what if you lost it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why not just delete it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why not just delete it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Because in the wrong hands, your 'trophies' pose an unprecedented security risk!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Because in the wrong hands, your 'trophies' pose an unprecedented security risk!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Because in the wrong hands, your 'trophies' pose an unprecedented security risk!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Because in the wrong hands, your 'trophies' pose an unprecedented security risk!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And what is that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And what is that?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He looks up to you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He looks up to you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You'll destroy the records of thousands of DNA Profiles if I get you the recipe for a brisket glaze?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You'll destroy the records of thousands of DNA Profiles if I get you the recipe for a brisket glaze?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You'll destroy the records of thousands of DNA Profiles if I get you the recipe for a brisket glaze?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You'll destroy the records of thousands of DNA Profiles if I get you the recipe for a brisket glaze?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fine I'll ask Marius.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fine I'll ask Marius.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can't you just make your own?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can't you just make your own?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Can't you just make your own?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Can't you just make your own?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think you underplayed how final the deal really was.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think you underplayed how final the deal really was.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think you underplayed how final the deal really was.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think you underplayed how final the deal really was.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He was just excited to meet you I think.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He was just excited to meet you I think.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: He was just excited to meet you I think.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: He was just excited to meet you I think.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: FYI: I love my legs.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: FYI: I love my legs.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What now? An arm?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What now? An arm?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: This is just about your ego.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This is just about your ego.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: This is just about your ego.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: This is just about your ego.
